news.title: Polymarket names former Amazon finance chief Warren Jenson as its first CFO
news.summary: Jenson becomes the prediction market’s first CFO as Polymarket builds its regulated U.S. exchange and global platform.

news.title: Monument Bank delays retail tokenized deposits, cites regulatory issues in the UK
news.summary: The London-based challenger bank tapped a Canadian custodian to meet the Financial Conduct Authority’s regulatory requirements. It now expects to roll out retail tokenized deposits by November.

news.title: Bitcoin Bancorp snaps up thousands of defunct Bitcoin Depot ATMs for $620,000
news.summary: Just over a quarter of Bitcoin Depot’s more than 9,200 kiosks have been sold for less than $1 million, court records show.

news.title: Crypto for Advisors: Hyperliquid and the future of finance
MoneyGram unveils stablecoin-backed card as digital dollars move into everyday spending
news.summary: The remittance giant is rolling out a Visa card that lets customers hold dollars and spend from a stablecoin-backed balance.

news.title: Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart, others ask EU to remove or increase cap in tokenization trial
news.summary: The coalition warned that the current limit is too low, noting some existing European projects already exceed it.

news.title: Threatened with arrest online? Recognizing a law enforcement impersonation scam
news.summary: So-called digital arrest scams use false claims of authority to pressure victims virtually into making rapid digital payments, including cryptocurrency transactions, writes Moody's Rich Graham.

news.title: Crypto researchers cut Bitcoin and Ethereum quantum attack estimate by 50%
news.summary: A paper shared with CoinDesk shows humans and AI agents beating Google’s March result on a core calculation used by Shor’s algorithm, adding another variable to crypto’s quantum clock.

news.title: Treasury yields surge toward the danger zone for stocks, as inflation pressures heat up
news.summary: Oil prices were at their highest levels since late May, while rising wholesale inflation data sent benchmark 10-year yields closer to the key 5% level.

news.title: Renewable-energy mandates are actually bad for consumers. They’re not great for solar stocks, either.
news.summary: Renewable-energy mandates in blue states are a major driver of higher electricity bills, adding directly to the cost-of-living problem.

news.title: Now’s your chance to make money during the best bond market for yields in decades — if you get over Treasury jitters
news.summary: If you looking for high income in the bond market, without paying taxes, here’s how you figure out how much interest you’re actually being paid.

news.title: Meta is winning over Wall Street with its new Muse AI agent
news.summary: A J.P. Morgan analyst recommends Meta’s stock following signs of progress on consumer-focused AI applications.

news.title: Derailing the AI train will be surprisingly difficult, according to Bank of America
news.summary: Proprietary measures of risk and investor anxiety — alongside historical perspective — persuade the bank that euphoria surrounding the AI trade has not reached bubble proportions.
